title: Musk's faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem | TechCrunch
summary: In Memphis, where SpaceXAI has run gas turbines to power its Colossus data centers since 2024, the NAACP has repeatedly accused the company of operating turbines without the permits or pollution controls required by federal law.
